terms.title: Terms & Conditions
paragraphs: Membership: A one-time ₹500 fee activates your Farm Club membership and is non-transferable.
Plot leases: Annual subscriptions attach to the plot you select. Multi-plot allocation within a single plan is subject to product rules.
Deliveries: Weekly boxes are delivered to addresses within city limits. Cancel only for weeks outside the two-week harvest lock window.
Billing: Renewals are billed manually at cycle end. CHEDI does not auto-charge your card.
Conduct: Misuse of membership, payment fraud, or abuse of delivery schedules may result in suspension.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We collect your name, phone, email, and delivery address to operate Farm Club membership and deliveries.
Payment card numbers and CVVs are never stored on CHEDI servers; they are tokenized via our payment partner.
You may request a copy of your data or delete your account from Settings. Financial records may be retained as required by law.
We use notifications (push, SMS, or email) based on your preferences to share delivery and harvest updates.
